description: Notify Godot's LSP that a file was modified and get updated diagnostics. Returns: diagnostics (errors/warnings) for the synced file. WHEN TO CALL: After using Edit/Write tools to modify a .gd file. The LSP does not watch files, so you must call this to refresh analysis. Optionally pass content directly to avoid reading from disk.

content.description: File content to sync (optional, reads from disk if not provided)

file.description: Absolute or relative path to the modified .gd file

name: gdscript_sync_file
